title: orthopogon undulatifolius
intro: Orthopogon undulatifolius, commonly known as 'Java Vetiver', is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The Java Vetiver plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to improve sleep quality, reduce stress, and alleviate anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Java Vetiver include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Java Vetiver include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
